detail: Heading exact: '01 / Мягкое облако'. Treatment: restrained elegant cyan ambient focus. Very thin low-contrast cyan edge plus a wide smooth low-opacity CYAN blur expanding evenly 24–32 screen pixels around the weight input, with no bright tight ring. A quiet floating pool of light, feathered outer falloff, subtle 6% cyan tint within input. Most understated variant for daily use.
prompt:
Create a polished square 1024x1024 UI design approval image. Use the provided workout screen ONLY as visual reference for palette, type and control design. Show a CLOSE-UP fragment of this Russian workout interface rather than the entire phone. Keep composition identical across variants: dark navy #040e28 canvas, small outside heading at top; centered dark blue #102342 workout card with heading 'Жим ногами', secondary 'Подход 2 из 3'; below two equally sized rounded input panels side by side: left label 'Вес, кг', minus button, editable value '80', plus button; right label 'Повторы', minus, value '10', plus. Under them a full width royal blue #1750ff 'Сохранить подход' button. Cyan accent #28d9f7. The LEFT WEIGHT INPUT is focused; the right input is neutral and MUST have no glow. Make the focused input glow artistically soft, blurred and tasteful, not a harsh 3px focus rectangle. Keep a thin legible edge and all text, numbers and icons perfectly sharp and white. No glow on the whole card or save button, no new colors, no lens flares, no particles, no invented fields, no extra small commentary, no changed page layout. At bottom outside the card show one small text 'Активное поле: вес'. This is a concrete UI mockup, not an abstract lighting illustration.
